disposition_reason: Original ICP-OES measurements of Cr, Cd, Pb, Cu, Zn, Sn and Fe in 37 commercial fruit juices bought in Sana'a food stores, one mean per juice in Table 2.

study.design: Market survey of packaged fruit juices (carton, glass, can, PET)
study.origin: mixed: locally produced (Yemeni fruit) and imported juices; origin of individual samples mostly not stated
study.market: Different food stores throughout Sana'a city, Yemen
study.period_text: Abstract says 2019; Introduction says purchased in 2018
study.method: 0.5 mL juice digested with HNO3/H2O2 at 200 °C, diluted to 50 mL; ICP-OES with axial plasma; triplicate analyses
study.qa: Accuracy checked with standard samples; LOD/LOQ from blanks; no certified reference material or recovery reported
